summary:
LEVEL 4 POLISH AUDIT - Batch 2: /wallet, /login, /register

=== PAGE: /wallet ===
SCORES: Visual:4 Hierarchy:4 Cognitive:4 Micro:3 Empty:5 Typo:4 Space:4 Color:4 = AVG: 4.0/5
GOOD:
- Balance display is prominent with large orange number + Lux unit - clear hero element
- Card-based layout with subtle gray backgrounds creates clear visual grouping
- Empty state for transactions is present with helpful text
- Identity section with Copy button and Show public key toggle is well-organized
- Focus ring on inputs is orange, matching the theme color
POLISH ISSUES:
- [MED] Send button is a small pill-style button while login/register use full-width CTAs - inconsistent button hierarchy
- [MED] Recipient peer ID field is a combobox but Amount is a spinbutton - different input types side by side
- [LOW] Your Balance label is in orange link-style text - could be confused as clickable
- [MED] Initial page load briefly shows simplified nav before full nav hydrates - layout shift
- [LOW] Console error: /api/auth/me returns 500 on every page load for unauthenticated users
MOBILE: Layout stacks correctly, identity truncates with ellipsis, good spacing and touch targets

=== PAGE: /login ===
SCORES: Visual:4 Hierarchy:5 Cognitive:5 Micro:4 Empty:N/A Typo:4 Space:5 Color:4 = AVG: 4.4/5
GOOD:
- Clean centered form with clear heading Welcome back + subtitle
- Excellent information hierarchy: heading > subtitle > form > CTA > secondary link
- Full-width orange CTA button is prominent and clear
- Placeholder alice or 12D3KooW... is helpful - shows both formats accepted
- Error state Invalid credentials uses pink background with red text - clear and non-aggressive
- Login button disables when fields empty, enables when filled - good affordance
POLISH ISSUES:
- [MED] Loading... flash in main content area during auth check - no skeleton or spinner
- [LOW] Nav layout shifts when auth check completes
- [LOW] No show password toggle on password field
- [LOW] Console error: /api/auth/me returns 500 instead of 401
MOBILE: Perfect mobile layout - full-width form, good spacing, no issues on 375x812

=== PAGE: /register ===
SCORES: Visual:4 Hierarchy:5 Cognitive:5 Micro:4 Empty:N/A Typo:4 Space:5 Color:4 = AVG: 4.4/5
GOOD:
- Visually identical structure to login - consistent product feel
- Three fields with clear labels: Username, Password with min 8 chars hint, Confirm Password
- Password mismatch validation uses same pink/red error styling as login
- Cross-link Already have an account? Login mirrors login page
POLISH ISSUES:
- [MED] Same Loading... flash as login during auth check
- [MED] No client-side validation before submit - button enables even with mismatched passwords
- [LOW] No password strength indicator
- [LOW] No show password toggle
MOBILE: Perfect mobile layout, mirrors login, all fields stack well

=== CROSS-PAGE CONSISTENCY ===
STRONG:
- /login and /register are nearly identical twins - same form width, heading style, button style, error styling. Score: 5/5
- All 3 pages use orange/amber accent color consistently
- All 3 pages share same nav bar structure
- Error messages use identical pink bg + red text treatment
- Mobile layouts consistently well-proportioned
- Focus rings are orange on all input types across all pages
INCONSISTENCIES:
- [MED] /wallet uses card-based layout vs /login /register centered white form - different architectures
- [MED] /wallet Send button is small pill vs /login /register full-width solid orange CTA
- [LOW] /wallet has no Loading flash while /login /register show Loading... text
- [LOW] /wallet has no subtitle while login/register both have heading + subtitle pairs

COMPARISON TO BATCH 1: /login and /register match /projects quality at 4.4/5. /wallet at 4.0/5 slightly below.

OVERALL BATCH 2 AVERAGE: 4.3/5

TOP 3 FIXES FOR MAXIMUM IMPACT:
1. [HIGH] Fix Loading... flash on /login and /register - add skeleton loader or spinner
2. [HIGH] Fix /api/auth/me returning 500 instead of 401 for unauthenticated users
3. [MED] Add client-side password match validation on /register before enabling Sign up button
